title: Observation
description: One stored data point. Every number in the system is a row like this, with its provenance.

source.description: Registry id of the source that produced the row, e.g. greenhouse_jobs.

source_url.description: Exact URL fetched, or a urn: for evidence without a URL (e.g. urn:yipitdata:weekly-2026-10-05).

as_of.description: The date the value describes (not when we fetched it).

retrieved_at.description: UTC time we fetched it, or the time it was entered for manual/ledger rows.

tier.description: Reliability tier: company-stated (company's own channel), filing (regulatory), platform (third-party telemetry such as npm or GitHub), press, vendor (licensed alt-data), derived (computed by us).

entity.description: Company slug from config/companies, e.g. anthropic, openai.

value.description: Always a number. Text facts (headlines, job titles) go in dims with value 1 so they can be counted.

dims.description: Extra dimensions, e.g. {"function": "research", "location": "London"}. Flat, scalar values only.

entered_by.description: Who entered a manual or ledger row (git user name).

evidence.description: Quote, page reference or file path backing a manual or ledger row.
